description: Test suite for the at::ITensorListRef and related classes in the ATen library, using Google Test framework to verify behavior of tensor list references, including boxed and unboxed tensors, optional tensors, and iterators.

classes.name: ITensorListRef
classes.description: Reference to a list of tensors, supporting boxed and unboxed representations, iteration, and materialization.

classes.name: IOptTensorListRef
classes.description: Reference to a list of optional tensors, supporting iteration.

methods.name: get_tensor_vector
methods.description: Creates a vector of 5 empty tensors.

methods.name: get_boxed_opt_tensor_vector
methods.description: Creates a vector of optional tensors with alternating values and nullopt.

methods.name: get_unboxed_opt_tensor_vector
methods.description: Creates a vector of optional tensor references from a static tensor vector.

methods.name: check_elements_same
methods.description: Checks if elements in a tensor list match a given vector, verifying use count and identity.
